summary_1line: Angada delivers Rama’s ultimatum to Ravana; after escaping capture, the monkey army launches a massive assault on Lanka’s fortified walls, beginning the great battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Angada, seized by four Rakshasas in Ravana’s court, suddenly leaps upward and lands on the golden palace terrace as his captors crash down below.
Millions of monkeys swarm the ramparts of Lanka, their yellow, red, and grey bodies covering the walls while dust clouds blot out the sun.
Monkeys tear down jeweled pillars and hurl catapults, stones, and weapons from the city walls into Lanka amid roaring battle with the Rakshasas.
